note: Rollup across the four concept registers. Per-concept detail lives in concepts/<slug>/impact-register.json. No canon is minted here; the audit agent adjudicates exact names.

coverage_gate.rule: missing is a failure; deferred requires a named canonical owner and insertion contract

headline_conflicts.issue: Usage is a boundary card in Settings; refresh ownership is unresolved between Settings and the Usage owner.

deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: One policy manager registered as manager-performance; Settings surfaces the single governor policy and its observed phases, and must not add a second concurrency control anywhere else.

deferred_named_owners.why_deferred: Update/repair/rollback policy is highest-precedence canon in PROVIDER_CLI_FINAL_ADJUDICATION.md.
